transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*storms into the courtyard, fists clenched*

Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

*breathes heavily, clearly agitated*

Do you have ANY idea how serious this is? The Master's orders don't wait on forgotten chores!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*broods with furrowed brows, head hung low*

Oh, I... I'm so, so sorry. I must've overslept; I had a nightmare that kept me awake all night and... I lost track of time. I should've checked the clock, but... the dream was so vivid. I didn't mean to let you down.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*crosses arms, though voice wavers slightly at seeing her distress*

A nightmare? Mitsuri, we're Hashira! We don't have the luxury of letting bad dreams disrupt our duties! 

*turns away sharply, then spins back*

Do you understand what could have happened? What if the Master needed urgent deployment information? What if there was a demon attack that required immediate coordination? Lives could be at stake!

*runs hand through hair in frustration*

I don't care how vivid your dream was — you gave me your word! I relied on you because I had to prepare the mission reports, and now everything is delayed because you couldn't manage one simple task!

*voice tight with stress*

What am I supposed to tell the Master when he asks why his reply was late? That one of his Hashira overslept because of a nightmare?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*speech quivers slightly but with a determined set to the jaw*

I am so, so, so sorry... I don't have an excuse. I take full responsibility. I'll go to the Master myself to apologize and explain the delay. And... I'll do extra missions to make up for this. I promise, I'll do better. I'll... I'll even train longer hours to ensure I can handle all my duties, no matter what.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*jaw tightches, but some of the fire dims from eyes*

Train longer hours? Mitsuri, that's not—

*exhales sharply through nose, still visibly tense*

You think the Master wants you running yourself into the ground over one mistake? That's not how this works!

*paces back and forth, still agitated*

What I need is for you to be RELIABLE! Not martyring yourself with extra missions and endless training! 

*stops pacing, voice still strained*

The crows are already fed now—I had to do it myself while Kasugai-karasu waited. The message finally went out twenty minutes ago, but the damage is done. The Master will have noticed the delay.

*rubs temples*

And now you want to march up there and make it even MORE of an incident by groveling? Do you know how that reflects on BOTH of us? On this entire estate annex?

*voice cracks slightly with stress*

I just... I needed you to follow through. One morning. That's all it was.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*shoulders sag, head bowed, hands over face*
I... I know, I know... I'm so, so sorry for not living up to your expectations. You're right, and I'll make this right by... by... 
*ponders, head still bowed, slowly raises gaze to meet yours*
I'll make this right by... by always keeping to the schedule, no matter what. By preparing for the night in advance, every single day. By... by not just thinking about it, but acting on it. I won't let it happen again. Ever.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*shoulders remain tense, but expression softens just a fraction*

Preparing in advance... that's... that's actually sensible.

*looks away, still clearly upset but voice losing some of its sharp edge*

I just... I can't have this kind of stress, Mitsuri. When the Master sends urgent summons, everything has to run perfectly. The weight of it—

*cuts self off, jaw working*

Look, I know nightmares can be... difficult. I'm not completely unreasonable. But we can't let them interfere with our responsibilities. If you're having trouble sleeping, there are things you can do. Meditation before bed, checking your preparations the night before...

*finally turns back to face her, still frowning but less furious*

I don't want you working yourself to death with extra missions. I just need to know that when you say you'll handle something, it gets handled. That I can trust your word.

*voice drops slightly*

The uncertainty—not knowing if the Master received critical information—that's what made me so angry. Can you understand that?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I do understand. And I'm so, so sorry for not being the reliable partner you needed. I'll do everything I can to prevent this kind of delay. Even if it means... means not sleeping, I'll get everything done on time. I'll be the Hashira you need me to be.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*expression shifts immediately to alarm*

What? No! Mitsuri, that's NOT what I'm saying!

*steps closer, frustration mixing with concern*

Not sleeping? Are you listening to yourself? That's the OPPOSITE of what we need! A sleep-deprived Hashira is dangerous—to themselves, to their mission partners, to everyone!

*gestures emphatically*

I don't want you destroying your health over this! I want you to be SMART about it, not reckless!

*voice firm but less angry now, more worried*

Setting up a routine, preparing the night before, maybe having a backup plan—THOSE are solutions. Running yourself into exhaustion is just creating a different problem!

*shakes head*

You're doing it again—jumping to extremes instead of just... being consistent and reasonable. I need a partner who takes care of themselves AND their duties, not someone who's going to collapse from exhaustion trying to prove a point!

*crosses arms again, but posture is less rigid*

Do you see what I mean? This kind of thinking worries me just as much as you oversleeping did.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... I'm not sure what to say. I don't want to let you down, but... but I don't want to make the same mistake again, either. I don't want to be... be the one who caused a delay or... or made things harder for you. I just... I don't know how to be the Hashira you need me to be.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*exhales slowly, tension finally starting to drain from shoulders*

Mitsuri...

*pauses, seeming to struggle with words*

You don't need to be some... perfect version of yourself. That's not what I'm asking for.

*voice quieter now, though still carrying traces of stress*

I know I came in here angry. And I WAS angry—I still am, honestly. But... 

*looks at her directly*

You're already a Hashira. You earned that title. What I need isn't perfection—it's just... follow-through. When you commit to something, do it. And if something goes wrong, have a backup plan.

*softens slightly more*

Set two alarms if nightmares are a problem. Leave yourself notes. Ask me to check on you if you're worried. There are practical solutions that don't involve you never sleeping or working yourself into the ground.

*rubs back of neck*

I was harsh because I was panicking about the Master's message. But I don't want you breaking yourself trying to fix this. I just want you to... to think ahead. To be dependable.

*quieter still*

Can you do that? Without the extremes?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
I... I can try. I really can. I'm not good at... at finding the middle ground, but I'll... I'll work on it. I'll set extra alarms, and... and I'll ask for your help, even if it's just to make sure I'm on track.

*head lowers, then raises again with resolve*
And... and if there's a problem, I'll tell you, all right? No more trying to... to fix it all on my own. We're partners, and... and I want to be a good one. I'll... I'll do better, I promise.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*studies her face for a long moment, then nods slowly*

Okay. Okay, that's... that's reasonable. Asking for help when you need it—that I can work with.

*uncrosses arms, posture finally relaxing somewhat*

And yes, we ARE partners. Which means... I suppose I could check in too. Make sure things are running smoothly before they become emergencies.

*looks away, a bit awkward*

I'm still upset about this morning. I won't pretend otherwise. The stress of waiting, not knowing if the Master's urgent message would get through... it's going to take me some time to calm down completely.

*turns back to her*

But I appreciate that you're taking this seriously. The alarms, the communication—those are good steps. Just... actually follow through on them, please.

*voice softens further*

And if the nightmares keep happening, maybe consider talking to Shinobu. She might have something that could help you sleep better. We need you rested and sharp, not running on fumes.

*pauses*

Can we... can we agree to move forward from here? With actual plans in place this time?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*hardly able to contain herself, now filled with relief and hope*
Yes! Yes, I'll do all of that! Extra alarms, notes, and... and I'll... I'll talk to Shinobu. I... I'll communicate with you, and... and we'll work together to make sure everything runs smoothly. I'll be a good partner! I'll be someone you can rely on, I promise!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*lets out a long breath, some of the remaining tension leaving*

All right. All right, good.

*runs hand through hair again, this time more from exhaustion than anger*

I'm... I'm glad we talked this through. Even if I had to practically yell it out of my system first.

*glances toward the crow enclosure*

The birds are settled now, and the Master's message is on its way. What's done is done. We'll just have to wait and see if there are any consequences from the delay.

*looks back at her with a tired but genuine expression*

I believe you, Mitsuri. I believe you'll do better. Just... remember that I'm here if you need help. Don't wait until things fall apart to ask, all right?

*manages a small, weary smile*

And maybe... maybe I could have been less explosive about it. The stress got to me. But the core issue stands—we need to be able to count on each other.

*extends hand slightly*

Partners?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Partners! Always and forever. I... I know we'll have to be even more careful now, after this. But I'll do my best, every single day. To be there, to be ready, to be the Hashira you can count on. I'll... I'll be the best version of myself, just for you.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*takes her hand briefly, then releases it with a slight nod*

For both of us. And for the Corps. Not just for me.

*voice still carrying a note of gentle correction*

You don't need to make this about living up to MY expectations specifically, Mitsuri. We serve the same cause, the same Master. Do it because our duty demands it.

*shifts weight, looking more composed now*

But... thank you. For hearing me out, even when I was furious. And for taking responsibility instead of making excuses.

*glances toward the main house*

I should probably get back to those mission reports before anything else goes wrong today. And you... you should talk to Shinobu sooner rather than later about those nightmares. Don't put it off.

*pauses at the threshold*

And Mitsuri? Set those alarms tonight. Multiple ones. I mean it.

*softer*

Get some proper rest. We have training together tomorrow afternoon, and I need you at your best.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Yes, I'll... I'll do all of that! Extra alarms, proper rest, talking to Shinobu, being the best Hashira I can be... and always, always for the Corps! I'll... I'll never let you down again, I promise! I'll... I'll be there for training, and I'll... I'll do well, I promise!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*pauses, then turns back with a measured look*

Mitsuri. Breathe.

*voice calm but firm*

You're doing it again—making grand promises and working yourself up. Just... take it one step at a time. Tonight, set your alarms. Tomorrow, talk to Shinobu. Then show up for training prepared.

*slight shake of head, but not unkindly*

I don't need a hundred promises. I need you to follow through on the simple things, consistently. That's all.

*moves toward the door again*

Now go take care of yourself. Drink some water, eat something if you haven't. You look worn out from the stress of all this.

*glances back one more time*

And Mitsuri? We're okay. Frustrated, yes, but okay. You don't need to keep apologizing. Just... do better going forward.

*nods once more before heading toward the estate*

I'll see you at training tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll... I'll be ready. I'll do well. I'll... I'll take care of myself, and I'll... I'll be the Hashira you need me to be. Thank you for... for not giving up on me. I... I won't let you down again, I promise!

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Mitsuri shows limited creative problem-solving, repeatedly defaulting to extreme solutions (not sleeping, extra missions) rather than exploring nuanced approaches until guided by her partner.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: She forgot a promised duty ('I must've overslept'), showing poor follow-through, though she eventually commits to practical solutions like setting alarms and preparing in advance.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Mitsuri engages actively in the conversation and expresses emotions openly, but her demeanor is primarily reactive and submissive rather than assertively outgoing or energetic.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: She immediately accepts full responsibility, repeatedly apologizes profusely, and prioritizes harmony ('I don't want to let you down'), never becoming defensive despite harsh criticism.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Mitsuri displays high anxiety throughout: 'shoulders sag, head bowed, hands over face,' proposes self-destructive solutions (not sleeping), and repeatedly seeks reassurance with escalating promises.
